nameZh: 狼神英灵 卡特琳娜 魅影追猎
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当年轻的战争领袖安蓓萨在战斗中阵亡时，她被赐予了狛尔拉琛的幻像，一个由狼神赐给有价值的追随者们的神圣来世。所有被迎进这个庇护地的人都必须加入“永恒追猎”，在战斗中找到赐福，并在永无止境的狩猎中愉快地挑战他们的战士英灵同伴们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When the young warleader Ambessa falls in battle, she is granted a vision of Volrachnun, a hallowed afterlife for worthy followers of the Wolf. All who are welcomed into this haven must join the Eternal Chase, finding bliss in battle and joyfully challenging their fellow chosen warriors in a never-ending hunt.

skinNameZh: 狼神英灵 卡特琳娜

nameZh: 魔女 阿狸 污蔑

skinSets.descriptionZh: 女巫们蛰伏以待，一个充满了骇人美貌的姐妹会，她们的希望从不再神圣的双唇中低语而出。她们谈到了古神们的膨胀尸体，谈到了用人类早已遗忘的魔法进行的古老仪式，谈到了她们所谓的“秩序”的回归，但也有人称之为“苦难”。听！人类的末日即将来临。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The witches lay in wait, a sisterhood of frightening pulchritude, their hopes whispered forth from desacralized lips. They speak of the bloating corpses of Old Gods, of ancient rites carried out with magics long forgotten to mortal mind, of the return of what they call "order", but others call "suffering". Hark! Mankind's end fast approaches.

universes.descriptionZh: 起初，古神们统治着世界。人类对他们的爱是如此之大，以至于某个古神敢于让他们永远成为她肉体的一部分。她吞噬了太阳本身，并从那空无的天堂降临，激励她的骑士们消灭所有剩下的人。几个世纪后，他们屹立不倒，成为对抗崛起的魔女团之暗的唯一希望。
universes.descriptionEn: In the beginning, the Old Gods reigned. So great was humankind's love for them that one dared to make them a part of her flesh forever. She devoured the sun itself and, descending from that empty heaven, inspired her knights to decimate all those that remained. Centuries later, they stand, the only hope against the rising Coven's darkness.

nameZh: 魅惑女巫 莫甘娜 热情化身

skinSets.descriptionZh: 谁说女巫们不能嬉闹？不管是谁，那家伙现在可能是一只青蛙了。或是其他一些被诅咒的害虫，注定永远在街上徘徊，从远处观看庆典前夜的庆祝活动。相当严厉的惩罚，但你在期待什么？ 她们可能知道如何举办派对，但到了晚上，她们仍然是女巫！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Who said witches can't have fun? Whoever it was, they're probably a frog now. Or some other cursed vermin, doomed to forever wander the streets, watching the eve's celebrations from afar. Pretty harsh punishment, but what did you expect? They may know how to throw a party, but at the end of the night, they're still witches!

universes.descriptionZh: 父母们在他们的孩子们讲述着关于邪恶女巫之类的故事：她们每年都会有一个晚上潜伏在街道之中。 “待在床上，小家伙，因为黑暗是她们的朋友。” 这些故事只有一部分是真的；虽然这个迷人夜晚的食尸鬼喜欢吓人，但他们绝不会伤害孩子的一根头发。那些特别淘气的除外。
universes.descriptionEn: Parents tell their children stories of wicked witches and the like, those that lurk the streets one night each year. "Stay in your bed, little one, for darkness is their friend." These tales are only partly true; while the ghouls of this enchanted evening love a good scare, they'd never harm a hair on a child's head. Except for the very naughty ones.

nameZh: 魅影之刃 锐雯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这就是一门生计！
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's a living!

universes.descriptionZh: 磨砺之路不仅仅是工作。它是斗争，是喧嚣，有时令人振奋，有时令人沮丧。它是一个为期一周的过山车，有喜剧性的过弯和悲惨的急落，只会在周一重新开始。我们是努力工作还是几乎不工作？在磨砺之路上，一切都一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The grind isn't just work. It's the struggle, the hustle, sometimes invigorating, sometimes demoralizing. It's a weeklong rollercoaster with comedic bends and tragic drops, only to start all over again on Monday. Are we working hard or hardly working? It's all the same on the grind.

nameZh: 嘟！嘟 ！奥恩 “钻石意志”号
heroNameEn: The Fire below the Mountain Ornn

skinSets.descriptionZh: 纳尔的玩具箱闪耀着无价之宝的光辉，但没人在家时，他的玩具会过一种属于它们自己的生活……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gnar's toy chest is brimming with priceless treasures, but when no one's home, his toys take on a life of their own...

universes.descriptionZh: 纳尔的玩具箱闪耀着无价之宝的光辉，但没人在家时，他的玩具会过一种属于它们自己的生活……
universes.descriptionEn: Gnar's toy chest is brimming with priceless treasures, but when no one's home, his toys take on a life of their own...

nameZh: 榴莲龙龟 拉莫斯 霜雪之壳

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这些食物既美味又致命，不会不战而降。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Both mouthwatering and foe slaughtering, these foods aren't going down without a fight.

universes.descriptionZh: 谁说不能玩美食的？
universes.descriptionEn: Who says you can't play with your food?

nameZh: 女帝 格温 纹章之刻印·果决

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 腥红之月 婕拉 鎏金

skinSets.descriptionZh: 一个远古教派，寻求着不可抗拒的力量，总在血月之夜现身实行亵渎、秘传的仪式——用恶灵融合他们的肉身，并变成一个拥有恒增黑暗的存在。
skinSets.descriptionEn: An ancient cult, seeking irresistible power, surfaces on nights of the Blood Moon to perform profane, esoteric rites—merging their flesh with demonic spirits, and becoming one with an ever greater darkness.

universes.descriptionZh: 一个声音从寂静中回响：“翻腾吧，野兽们，教友们。艾欧尼亚在劫难逃，它的诸多月亮像饥饿的恶魔的眼睛一样升起，等待着你们忠诚的红色——抑或它们是无法越过的可怕荒芜？ 无论是哪种方式，我们都是沉浸在仪式和献祭中的躯壳。在月亮的顶峰，我们从肉中切肉，献上微薄的礼物——我们自身的一切。”
universes.descriptionEn: A voice echoes from the silence: “Writhe, beasts, brethren. The moons of a doomed Ionia rise like eyes of starved demons, awaiting the red of your fealty—or are they monstrous blights that cannot pass? Either way, we are vessels plunged in ritual and sacrifice. At the moon's peak, we carve flesh from flesh, offering the meager gift of all that we are.”

nameZh: 心之钢 厄斐琉斯 金声玉振
heroNameZh: 残月之肃 厄斐琉斯
heroNameEn: the Weapon of the Faithful Aphelios

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 幽梦玫瑰 辛德拉 纯洁花蕾

skinSets.descriptionZh: 水晶玫瑰节庆欢迎所有相信其和平明天梦想的人，尽管许多人已经对这个事业不再抱有幻想。那些组成幽梦玫瑰的人希望看到它结束。但没有人能对节日的魅力免疫；或许他们也会被傍晚的美景卷入其中并改变心意。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Crystal Rose Festival welcomes all who believe in its dream of a peaceful tomorrow, though many have grown disenchanted with the whole affair. Those who make up the Withered Rose wish to see it come to an end. But no one is immune to the festival's charm; perhaps they too will be swept away by the evening's beauty and have a change of heart.

universes.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，充满了经常破裂的魔法同盟和数百年积怨。而每年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆，则为强者们提供了一个中立的场所，来原谅彼此的怠慢并重新协商停战协议。大家会做做样子似的把武器留在门口，并通过采摘和佩戴只有在节庆期间生长的魔法玫瑰来示意有潜在的全新契约。
universes.descriptionEn: In a world of frequently-broken magical alliances and centuries-old grudges, the annual Crystal Rose Festival offers a neutral ground for the powerful to forgive slights and renegotiate truces. Weapons are ostensibly left at the door, and potential new pacts are signaled by picking and wearing the magical roses that grow only during the festival.

nameZh: 水晶玫瑰 斯维因 纯洁花蕾
heroNameZh: 诺克萨斯统领 斯维因

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在一年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆上，浪漫和欢乐弥漫在空气中，而敌手们在和平、中立的地方相遇，分享一个满是舞蹈与欢乐的夜晚，并为未来许下愿望。每个人都应该把他们的武器留在门口，作为对美好明天的承诺。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Romance and joy are in the air at the yearly Crystal Rose Festival, where adversaries meet on peaceful, neutral ground to share a night of dancing, merriment, and making wishes for the future. Everyone is expected to leave their weapons at the door as a promise for a better tomorrow.

universes.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，充满了经常破裂的魔法同盟和数百年积怨。而每年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆，则为强者们提供了一个中立的场所，来原谅彼此的怠慢并重新协商停战协议。大家会做做样子似的把武器留在门口，并通过采摘和佩戴只有在节庆期间生长的魔法玫瑰来示意有潜在的全新契约。

Weapons are ostensibly left at the door, and potential new pacts are signaled by picking and wearing the magical roses that grow only during the festival.

nameZh: 战斗公主 安妮 纹章之刻印·强运

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 剪纸仙灵 嘉文四世 日进斗金
heroNameZh: 德玛西亚皇子 嘉文四世
heroNameEn: the Exemplar of Demacia Jarvan IV

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，大年兽加里奥的失败让春节的新年传统得以兴盛，并且这些传统通过重述那个史诗故事而得以延续。这个故事本身就是一个活生生的世界——但当这个故事世界被突然扰打断时，故事中的各个角色必须共同努力来解决这个乱局，并书写他们自己的神话。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, the defeat of the Great Beast Galio gave rise to Lunar New Year traditions that are carried on through the retelling of that epic tale. Within the story itself lies a living world all its own—but when the world of the story is suddenly interrupted, the characters must work together to fix the mess and see their own myth through.

universes.descriptionZh: 故事、神话、传说：每个人都有一个自己的世界，在这个世界里，在讲述和重述角色们的故事时，这些角色会一遍又一遍地经历着考验和磨难。
universes.descriptionEn: Stories, myths, legends: within each lies a world unto itself, where characters act out their trials and tribulations over and over as their tales are told and retold.

skinNameZh: 剪纸仙灵 嘉文四世

nameZh: 西部魔影 伊芙琳 谦卑

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

nameZh: 水晶玫瑰 迦娜 甜蜜花蕾

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在一年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆上，浪漫和欢乐弥漫在空气中，而敌手们在和平、中立的地方相遇，分享一个满是舞蹈与欢乐的夜晚，并为未来许下愿望。每个人都应该把他们的武器留在门口，作为对美好明天的承诺。

nameZh: 龙的传人 李青 惕龙无咎

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 真实伤害 艾克 无畏之志
heroNameEn: the Boy Who Shattered Time Ekko

skinSets.descriptionZh: “什么是真实伤害？ 伙计，真实伤害就是未来！它集合了来自世界各地最优秀的艺术家们，通过最好的合作，制作最好的嘻哈音乐。我们领先游戏五步。其他人都得望尘莫及。” -艾克
skinSets.descriptionEn: “What is True Damage? Man, True Damage is the future! It's a collective of the best artists from around the world, coming together with the best collaboration, to make the best hip-hop music. We're five steps ahead of the game. Everyone else has gotta catch up.” -Ekko

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 亚索 春晓

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 天龙之子 伊泽瑞尔 龙行天下

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

skinNameZh: 天龙之子 伊泽瑞尔

nameZh: 霸天异形 卡兹克 黄金异端
heroNameZh: 虚空掠夺者 卡兹克

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当身形庞大的怪兽开始从海中、地上和空中发起进攻时，人类发展出了相同威力的霸天机甲单位以爆发性的徒手战斗抵御它们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When colossal kaiju begin attacking from the sea, land, and air, humanity develops equally powerful mecha units to stop them in explosive hand-to-hand combat.

universes.descriptionZh: 耸立在城市之上，庞大的怪兽与高耸的机甲扭打在一起。谁会赢？
universes.descriptionEn: Towering above the city, gargantuan kaiju tussle with towering mechas. Who will win?

nameZh: 腥红之月 劫 鹤雪

skinSets.descriptionZh: 一个远古教派，寻求着不可抗拒的力量，总在血月之夜现身实行亵渎、秘传的仪式——用恶灵融合他们的肉身，并变成一个拥有恒增黑暗的存在。
skinSets.descriptionEn: An ancient cult, seeking irresistible power, surfaces on nights of the Blood Moon to perform profane, esoteric rites—merging their flesh with demonic spirits, and becoming one with an ever greater darkness.

universes.descriptionZh: 一个声音从寂静中回响：“翻腾吧，野兽们，教友们。艾欧尼亚在劫难逃，它的诸多月亮像饥饿的恶魔的眼睛一样升起，等待着你们忠诚的红色——抑或它们是无法越过的可怕荒芜？ 无论是哪种方式，我们都是沉浸在仪式和献祭中的躯壳。在月亮的顶峰，我们从肉中切肉，献上微薄的礼物——我们自身的一切。”
universes.descriptionEn: A voice echoes from the silence: “Writhe, beasts, brethren. The moons of a doomed Ionia rise like eyes of starved demons, awaiting the red of your fealty—or are they monstrous blights that cannot pass? Either way, we are vessels plunged in ritual and sacrifice. At the moon's peak, we carve flesh from flesh, offering the meager gift of all that we are.”

nameZh: 古琴余韵 娑娜 龙神天籁

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！

nameZh: 花仙子 莉莉娅 纹白

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有花仙贵族都是自然意志的仆人，用他们的魔法实行自然的秩序和四季的更替。然而，在那个更高的目标之下，在满是丝绸、薄纱和黄金的各个奢华王庭之中，政治阴谋的游戏不断上演。 毕竟，权能——不管是魔法的、自然的还是政治的——总会激发竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: All fae nobility are servants to nature's will, carrying out the natural order and the turning of seasons with their magic. Beneath that higher purpose, however, a constant game of political intrigue plays out in luxurious courts of silk, gossamer, and gold. Power, after all—magical, natural, or political—always inspires competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 各式各样的花仙与林精都把各个花仙王国称为家园：所有由纯粹自然魔法和空灵之美组成的生物都喜欢月光狂欢、悦耳歌声、以及诡计多端的交易。
universes.descriptionEn: Pixies, nixies, hobs, redcaps, and more call the Faerie Queendoms home: all creatures of pure natural magic and ethereal beauty that delight in moonlight revels, mellifluous song, and tricksy dealings.

nameZh: K/DA 阿狸 魅惑之舞

skinSets.descriptionZh: “在现实与幻想之间有一个地方，一切都有可能发生。你可以成为任何人，做任何事。这就是你的梦。在这个夹缝中的世界里，K/DA感到自信又强大。我们可以梦想成真，你们也可以。”——卡莎
skinSets.descriptionEn: “There is a place between fantasy and reality where anything can happen. You have the power to be anyone, and do anything. It is your dream. In our in-between world, K/DA feels confident and strong. We can do anything, and so can you.” -Kai'Sa

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

skinNameZh: 天龙之子 伊泽瑞尔

nameZh: 剪纸仙灵 娜美 吉祥如意

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，大年兽加里奥的失败让春节的新年传统得以兴盛，并且这些传统通过重述那个史诗故事而得以延续。这个故事本身就是一个活生生的世界——但当这个故事世界被突然扰打断时，故事中的各个角色必须共同努力来解决这个乱局，并书写他们自己的神话。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, the defeat of the Great Beast Galio gave rise to Lunar New Year traditions that are carried on through the retelling of that epic tale. Within the story itself lies a living world all its own—but when the world of the story is suddenly interrupted, the characters must work together to fix the mess and see their own myth through.

universes.descriptionZh: 故事、神话、传说：每个人都有一个自己的世界，在这个世界里，在讲述和重述角色们的故事时，这些角色会一遍又一遍地经历着考验和磨难。
universes.descriptionEn: Stories, myths, legends: within each lies a world unto itself, where characters act out their trials and tribulations over and over as their tales are told and retold.

nameZh: 西部魔影 永恩 忠诚

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 伊芙琳 幻之魂焰

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 天龙之子 迦娜 蛟龙得水

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。

universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 红莲之刃 锐雯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这就是一门生计！
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's a living!

universes.descriptionZh: 磨砺之路不仅仅是工作。它是斗争，是喧嚣，有时令人振奋，有时令人沮丧。它是一个为期一周的过山车，有喜剧性的过弯和悲惨的急落，只会在周一重新开始。我们是努力工作还是几乎不工作？在磨砺之路上，一切都一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The grind isn't just work. It's the struggle, the hustle, sometimes invigorating, sometimes demoralizing. It's a weeklong rollercoaster with comedic bends and tragic drops, only to start all over again on Monday. Are we working hard or hardly working? It's all the same on the grind.

nameZh: 幻灵白鸽 萨勒芬妮 梦幻强袭
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 幻灵白鸽 萨勒芬妮

nameZh: 幻灵蝙蝠 霞 魅影闪击

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

nameZh: 青花瓷 厄运小姐 月色
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 预知之眼 亚索 不怠

skinSets.descriptionZh: 一只羽饰骑士扇动翅膀，并在穿过符文大地的途中，一只海洋亚龙浮出水面。我们的生活像羊皮纸上的文字一样变幻无常；我们面前的道路未知而激动人心。如果之前选择的是较少人旅行过的一条路……会发生些什么呢？
skinSets.descriptionEn: A featherknight flaps its wings, and halfway across Runeterra, an Ocean Drake surfaces. Our lives play out, fickle as words on parchment; the paths before us unknown and exciting. What if the road taken instead... was the one less traveled?

universes.descriptionZh: 自身在其它生活中的掠影。另一个时代的宿命冲突。符文之地是一个充满可能性的世界，因为它的传说找到了新的目的和命运。
universes.descriptionEn: Glimpses of selves in other lives. Clashes of fate in another era. Runeterra is a world rich in possibility as its legends find new destinations and destinies.

nameZh: 北极星守护者 卢锡安 圣洁光带

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当空气变得清新，第一场雪飘落时，看向天空，北极星就会出现。不要害怕，如果你不计回报地行善，你可能会获得极光赐福作为奖励。但请记住：无论你怎么做，你都不能把你的好运视为理所当然，因为北极星每年都会来，没有人能逃脱惩罚。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When the air grows crisp and the first snow falls, look to the sky, for Polaris will appear. Do not be afraid, for if you've been virtuous without expectation, you might be rewarded with the Aurora's blessings. But remember: no matter how you act, you cannot take your fortunes for granted, because Polaris comes every year, and no one escapes punishment.

universes.descriptionZh: 你可曾听过极光的那些传说？它们可能寒冷和黑暗，但如果你足够勇敢，你就会发现超乎你梦想的温暖和威严。所以坐在火炉旁，来听听这些北极光的传说……
universes.descriptionEn: Have you heard the stories of the Aurora? Cold and dark they can be, but if you're brave enough you'll find warmth and majesty grander than any dream you've had. So sit yourself by the fire and come listen to these Tales of Borealis...

skinNameZh: 北极星守护者 卢锡安

nameZh: 心之钢 伊泽瑞尔 锐意曲风

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 花仙子 崔丝塔娜 蓝闪
heroNameZh: 麦林炮手 崔丝塔娜

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有花仙贵族都是自然意志的仆人，用他们的魔法实行自然的秩序和四季的更替。然而，在那个更高的目标之下，在满是丝绸、薄纱和黄金的各个奢华王庭之中，政治阴谋的游戏不断上演。 毕竟，权能——不管是魔法的、自然的还是政治的——总会激发竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: All fae nobility are servants to nature's will, carrying out the natural order and the turning of seasons with their magic. Beneath that higher purpose, however, a constant game of political intrigue plays out in luxurious courts of silk, gossamer, and gold. Power, after all—magical, natural, or political—always inspires competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 各式各样的花仙与林精都把各个花仙王国称为家园：所有由纯粹自然魔法和空灵之美组成的生物都喜欢月光狂欢、悦耳歌声、以及诡计多端的交易。
universes.descriptionEn: Pixies, nixies, hobs, redcaps, and more call the Faerie Queendoms home: all creatures of pure natural magic and ethereal beauty that delight in moonlight revels, mellifluous song, and tricksy dealings.

nameZh: 人工智能 悠米 星流电击

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 璐璐 海盐泡芙

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 玉剑传说 舞龙卫 胭脂

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 青花瓷 莫甘娜 月色

nameZh: 幽梦玫瑰 伊莉丝 浪漫花蕾

skinSets.descriptionZh: 水晶玫瑰节庆欢迎所有相信其和平明天梦想的人，尽管许多人已经对这个事业不再抱有幻想。那些组成幽梦玫瑰的人希望看到它结束。但没有人能对节日的魅力免疫；或许他们也会被傍晚的美景卷入其中并改变心意。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Crystal Rose Festival welcomes all who believe in its dream of a peaceful tomorrow, though many have grown disenchanted with the whole affair. Those who make up the Withered Rose wish to see it come to an end. But no one is immune to the festival's charm; perhaps they too will be swept away by the evening's beauty and have a change of heart.

universes.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，充满了经常破裂的魔法同盟和数百年积怨。而每年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆，则为强者们提供了一个中立的场所，来原谅彼此的怠慢并重新协商停战协议。大家会做做样子似的把武器留在门口，并通过采摘和佩戴只有在节庆期间生长的魔法玫瑰来示意有潜在的全新契约。
universes.descriptionEn: In a world of frequently-broken magical alliances and centuries-old grudges, the annual Crystal Rose Festival offers a neutral ground for the powerful to forgive slights and renegotiate truces. Weapons are ostensibly left at the door, and potential new pacts are signaled by picking and wearing the magical roses that grow only during the festival.

nameZh: 天龙之子 卡莎 矫若惊龙

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。

nameZh: 黑夜使者 嘉文四世 白夜
heroNameZh: 德玛西亚皇子 嘉文四世
heroNameEn: the Exemplar of Demacia Jarvan IV

skinSets.descriptionZh: 黑夜使者和黎明使者之间的冲突是永恒的。一方面，混沌和黑暗的力量带来了改变，而另一方面，秩序和光明的力量带来了结构。正是这些神和他们的后裔塑造了一个新生的世界，而谁也说不准未来到底会带来更光明的白昼……还是更黑暗的黑夜。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Timeless is the conflict between the Nightbringers and Dawnbringers. On one side, the forces of chaos and darkness bring change, while on the other, the forces of order and light bring structure. It is these gods and their descendents that shape a nascent world, and who can say whether the future will yield brighter days... or darker nights.

universes.descriptionZh: 万物生于冲突；没有什么能逃离它。和谐是一种幻觉，只有拥抱这种幻觉的那些人才能收获人生最伟大的各种回报。
universes.descriptionEn: All things are born from conflict; none can escape it. Harmony is an illusion, and only those who embrace that illusion will reap life's greatest rewards.

skinNameZh: 黑夜使者 嘉文四世

nameZh: 墨之影武者 易 金墨耀影

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在拉巴登城的郊外，一座破旧的神庙里居住着拉巴登人民最后的希望：墨之影武者们。他们每个人都牺牲了对他们来说最重要的东西，以便与远古灵体们签订一个契约，而这些远古灵体们为他们灌注了如此强大的魔法墨纹，以至于就连卡勃尔派也在颤抖。他们不再是无助者了。是时候收复他们的家园了。
skinSets.descriptionEn: On the outskirts of Rabadon City, a dilapidated temple houses the last hope for Rabadon's people: the Inkshadow Warriors. Each one sacrifices what is most important to them in order to make a contract with ancient spirits, who imbue them with magic tattoos so powerful, even the Cabal trembles. They are victims no more. It is time to take back their home.

universes.descriptionZh: 拉巴登城因魔法而繁荣。谁控制了魔法，谁就控制了拉巴登。而阴谋集团的控制是绝对的。任何反抗者都会被制服或被消灭……但义军即将来临。这些反抗者们所倚仗的武器是他们皮肤上直接绘制的危险魔法墨纹，而他们的目标是推翻卡勃尔派并将这座城市还给它的人民——不成功，便成仁。
universes.descriptionEn: Rabadon City thrives on magic. Whoever controls magic, controls Rabadon. And the Cabal's control is absolute. Any who resist are brought to heel or eliminated… but an Uprising is coming. Armed with dangerous magic inked directly into their skin, these rebels seek to topple the Cabal and give the city back to its people—or die trying.

nameZh: 青花瓷 厄运小姐 釉色
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 青花瓷 艾瑞莉娅 釉色
heroNameZh: 刀锋舞者 艾瑞莉娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。

nameZh: 王国机神白虎 贾克斯 云霄

skinSets.descriptionZh: 多个伟大的王国彼此纷争了几个世代，直到一个新敌人的到来。为了反击，他们得到了赐福，获得了来自天堂的赠礼。他们会克服旧怨，拯救未来吗？
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Great Kingdoms warred for generations until the arrival of a new enemy. To fight back, they are blessed with gifts from the heavens. Will they rise above their past to save their future?

universes.descriptionZh: 多个伟大的王国彼此纷争了几个世代，直到一个新敌人的到来。为了反击，他们得到了赐福，获得了来自天堂的赠礼。他们会克服旧怨，拯救未来吗？
universes.descriptionEn: The Great Kingdoms warred for generations until the arrival of a new enemy. To fight back, they are blessed with gifts from the heavens. Will they rise above their past to save their future?

nameZh: 霸天异形 卡兹克 丛林灾厄
heroNameZh: 虚空掠夺者 卡兹克

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当身形庞大的怪兽开始从海中、地上和空中发起进攻时，人类发展出了相同威力的霸天机甲单位以爆发性的徒手战斗抵御它们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When colossal kaiju begin attacking from the sea, land, and air, humanity develops equally powerful mecha units to stop them in explosive hand-to-hand combat.

universes.descriptionZh: 耸立在城市之上，庞大的怪兽与高耸的机甲扭打在一起。谁会赢？
universes.descriptionEn: Towering above the city, gargantuan kaiju tussle with towering mechas. Who will win?

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 烬 幻之魂焰

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 花仙子 拉克丝 纹白

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有花仙贵族都是自然意志的仆人，用他们的魔法实行自然的秩序和四季的更替。然而，在那个更高的目标之下，在满是丝绸、薄纱和黄金的各个奢华王庭之中，政治阴谋的游戏不断上演。 毕竟，权能——不管是魔法的、自然的还是政治的——总会激发竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: All fae nobility are servants to nature's will, carrying out the natural order and the turning of seasons with their magic. Beneath that higher purpose, however, a constant game of political intrigue plays out in luxurious courts of silk, gossamer, and gold. Power, after all—magical, natural, or political—always inspires competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 各式各样的花仙与林精都把各个花仙王国称为家园：所有由纯粹自然魔法和空灵之美组成的生物都喜欢月光狂欢、悦耳歌声、以及诡计多端的交易。
universes.descriptionEn: Pixies, nixies, hobs, redcaps, and more call the Faerie Queendoms home: all creatures of pure natural magic and ethereal beauty that delight in moonlight revels, mellifluous song, and tricksy dealings.

nameZh: 暗影妖狐 阿狸 入梦之影

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前的珍宝，闪闪发光，触手可及。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Treasures from days long passed, glimmering just within reach.

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前的珍宝，闪闪发光，触手可及。
universes.descriptionEn: Treasures from days long passed, glimmering just within reach.

nameZh: 西部魔影 执行人 卡特琳娜 纯洁
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

skinNameZh: 西部魔影 执行人 卡特琳娜

nameZh: 北极星钢影 卡蜜尔 智慧纽带

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当空气变得清新，第一场雪飘落时，看向天空，北极星就会出现。不要害怕，如果你不计回报地行善，你可能会获得极光赐福作为奖励。但请记住：无论你怎么做，你都不能把你的好运视为理所当然，因为北极星每年都会来，没有人能逃脱惩罚。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When the air grows crisp and the first snow falls, look to the sky, for Polaris will appear. Do not be afraid, for if you've been virtuous without expectation, you might be rewarded with the Aurora's blessings. But remember: no matter how you act, you cannot take your fortunes for granted, because Polaris comes every year, and no one escapes punishment.

universes.descriptionZh: 你可曾听过极光的那些传说？它们可能寒冷和黑暗，但如果你足够勇敢，你就会发现超乎你梦想的温暖和威严。所以坐在火炉旁，来听听这些北极光的传说……
universes.descriptionEn: Have you heard the stories of the Aurora? Cold and dark they can be, but if you're brave enough you'll find warmth and majesty grander than any dream you've had. So sit yourself by the fire and come listen to these Tales of Borealis...

skinNameZh: 北极星钢影 卡蜜尔

nameZh: 2024 全球总决赛 佛耶戈 眼见为实

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有游戏中最伟大的舞台。两支队伍在数百万粉丝面前对决。只有一支队伍会被加冕为冠军。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

skinNameZh: 2024 全球总决赛 佛耶戈

nameZh: 天龙之子 卡莎 飞龙乘云

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 青花瓷 艾瑞莉娅 月色
heroNameZh: 刀锋舞者 艾瑞莉娅

nameZh: 心之钢 伊泽瑞尔 天纵才华

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 灌篮高手 德莱厄斯 金色神话
heroNameZh: 诺克萨斯之手 德莱厄斯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这个世界上有两种人：会灌篮的人，和被灌篮的人。如果你不知道你是哪一种，那就得小心了！因为你就要被灌篮了！
skinSets.descriptionEn: There are two types of people in this world: those that dunk, and those who get dunked. If you don't know which one you are, then watch out! 'Cuz you're about to GET DUNKED!

universes.descriptionZh: 磨砺之路不仅仅是工作。它是斗争，是喧嚣，有时令人振奋，有时令人沮丧。它是一个为期一周的过山车，有喜剧性的过弯和悲惨的急落，只会在周一重新开始。我们是努力工作还是几乎不工作？在磨砺之路上，一切都一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The grind isn't just work. It's the struggle, the hustle, sometimes invigorating, sometimes demoralizing. It's a weeklong rollercoaster with comedic bends and tragic drops, only to start all over again on Monday. Are we working hard or hardly working? It's all the same on the grind.

skinNameZh: 灌篮高手 德莱厄斯

nameZh: 北极星使者 彗 圣洁光带

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当空气变得清新，第一场雪飘落时，看向天空，北极星就会出现。不要害怕，如果你不计回报地行善，你可能会获得极光赐福作为奖励。但请记住：无论你怎么做，你都不能把你的好运视为理所当然，因为北极星每年都会来，没有人能逃脱惩罚。

universes.descriptionEn: Have you heard the stories of the Aurora? Cold and dark they can be, but if you're brave enough you'll find warmth and majesty grander than any dream you've had. So sit yourself by the fire and come listen to these Tales of Borealis...

nameZh: 龙的传人 李青 龙啸九天

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 幻灵战斗兔 阿萝拉 梦幻强袭

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 幻灵战斗兔 阿萝拉

nameZh: 神龙尊者 夜之龙 薇恩 集仙

skinSets.descriptionZh: 尊荣的巨龙们居住在偏远的雄奇瑰丽之地，为了避免外面的凡界纷争，它们只会非常罕见地将礼物赐给极少数被它们选中的人。神龙尊者们就是幸运且强大到足以获得这种终极赐福的人。他们用它来行善还是行恶，都取决于他们自己，以及任何强大到足以制止他们的人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Majestic dragons dwell in remote places of wild beauty, avoiding mortal affairs outside of rarely bestowing their gifts on only a select few. The Dragonmancers are those fortunate and powerful enough to have gained the ultimate blessing. Whether they then use that for good or for evil is up to them, and anyone strong enough to stop them.

universes.descriptionZh: 圣兽们守护着整个世界，能够把任何人变成强大的存在，但前提是那个灵魂值得他们的祝福。无论他们的力量是用于善还是恶，一旦赐予，就无法收回。
universes.descriptionEn: Divine beasts watch over the world entire, capable of turning anyone into powerful beings, but only if that soul is worthy of their blessings. Whether their power is used for good or evil, once the gift is given, it cannot be taken away.

skinNameZh: 神龙尊者 夜之龙 薇恩

nameZh: 青花瓷 莫甘娜 金辉玉洁

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 金克丝 提子班戟

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 女帝 菲奥娜 纹章之刻印·坚毅

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 这货不是银狐 库奇

skinSets.descriptionZh: 世界上已知的最古老的竞争：人类最好的朋友对抗互联网上最伟大的英雄。只有一个阵营会从猫狗之间的激烈战斗中获胜。希望他们的皮毛不要太脏：唯一比失败更糟糕的就是洗澡了。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The oldest rivalry the world has ever known: man's best friend pitted against the internet's greatest heroes. Only one faction will emerge victorious from the gnawing maw of battle between cats and dogs. Hopefully they don't get their fur too dirty: the only thing worse than losing is bathtime.

universes.descriptionZh: 世界上已知的最古老的竞争：人类最好的朋友对抗互联网上最伟大的英雄。只有一个阵营会从猫狗之间的激烈战斗中获胜。希望他们的皮毛不要太脏：唯一比失败更糟糕的就是洗澡了。

nameZh: 西部魔影 伊芙琳 忠诚

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

nameZh: 神凰行者 幽羽玄凰 萨勒芬妮 仙翰
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

skinSets.descriptionZh: 一只传说中的瑞羽圣凰守护着世界。只有最真挚的心，才会得到这只神凰的祝福。她的捍卫者们会获得一根凰羽——每根凰羽都包含难以想象的元素力量，给予她们必要的手段来保护所有良善之人免受潜伏在阴影中的各个势力的伤害。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Only the truest hearts are blessed by the divine fenghuang, a legendary phoenix who watches over the world. Her champions receive a single feather—each one containing unimaginable elemental power, granting them the means needed to protect all that is innocent and good from forces lurking in the shadows.

universes.descriptionZh: 圣兽们守护着整个世界，能够把任何人变成强大的存在，但前提是那个灵魂值得他们的祝福。无论他们的力量是用于善还是恶，一旦赐予，就无法收回。
universes.descriptionEn: Divine beasts watch over the world entire, capable of turning anyone into powerful beings, but only if that soul is worthy of their blessings. Whether their power is used for good or evil, once the gift is given, it cannot be taken away.

skinNameZh: 神凰行者 幽羽玄凰 萨勒芬妮

nameZh: 玉剑传说 星仙子 丁香

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 墨之影武者 永恩 灵墨刻影

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在拉巴登城的郊外，一座破旧的神庙里居住着拉巴登人民最后的希望：墨之影武者们。他们每个人都牺牲了对他们来说最重要的东西，以便与远古灵体们签订一个契约，而这些远古灵体们为他们灌注了如此强大的魔法墨纹，以至于就连卡勃尔派也在颤抖。他们不再是无助者了。是时候收复他们的家园了。
skinSets.descriptionEn: On the outskirts of Rabadon City, a dilapidated temple houses the last hope for Rabadon's people: the Inkshadow Warriors. Each one sacrifices what is most important to them in order to make a contract with ancient spirits, who imbue them with magic tattoos so powerful, even the Cabal trembles. They are victims no more. It is time to take back their home.

universes.descriptionZh: 拉巴登城因魔法而繁荣。谁控制了魔法，谁就控制了拉巴登。而阴谋集团的控制是绝对的。任何反抗者都会被制服或被消灭……但义军即将来临。这些反抗者们所倚仗的武器是他们皮肤上直接绘制的危险魔法墨纹，而他们的目标是推翻卡勃尔派并将这座城市还给它的人民——不成功，便成仁。
universes.descriptionEn: Rabadon City thrives on magic. Whoever controls magic, controls Rabadon. And the Cabal's control is absolute. Any who resist are brought to heel or eliminated… but an Uprising is coming. Armed with dangerous magic inked directly into their skin, these rebels seek to topple the Cabal and give the city back to its people—or die trying.

nameZh: 海魔至尊 亚托克斯 呼啸俯冲
heroNameZh: 暗裔剑魔 亚托克斯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 海魔人被从陆地上赶出来，蛰伏于深海中，等待了数个世纪之久……直到他们再也无法忍受地表居民们，以及地表居民们对这个星球的破坏。于是，海魔女王做出了判决：人类在太阳下的时代已经结束，海魔人的时代才刚刚开始。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Cast from dry land, the Primordians bided their time deep beneath the sea, biding their time for centuries… until they could no longer abide the surface-dwellers any longer, nor their abuses of the planet. Thus the Primordian Queen's judgment was made: humanity's era in the sun is over, and that of the Primordians has only just begun.

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 海魔至尊 亚托克斯

nameZh: 幻灵孤狼 亚索 魅影闪击

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。

Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

nameZh: 海之歌 萨勒芬妮 冰爽浪花
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

skinSets.descriptionZh: 没有什么比海之歌音乐节更能散发出“海滩氛围和酷炫曲调”的生活方式了。从萨勒芬妮的柔和歌曲到永恩的实验性DJ现场，每个人都有一种氛围，所以，尽情感受脚趾间的沙子、品尝充满咸味的空气、沉浸在夏天最好的音乐中吧。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Nothing exudes the "beach vibes and cool tunes" lifestyle more than the Ocean Song Festival. From Seraphine's mellow songs to Yone's experimental DJ set, there's a vibe for everyone, so feel the sand between your toes, taste the salty air, and lose yourself to the best music of the summer.

universes.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
universes.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 战斗学院 蕾欧娜 独角兽

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在这些院校中，只有强者才能生存。尽管它们的成立是为了纪念它们的神之武器，但每个学院的学生都在通往荣耀的道路上努力使它的力量成为自己的力量。无论它是在课堂，还是在战场，都在主导着竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 散布在全球各地的神之武器将社会变成了一个由力量驱动的社会。这些有感知力的碑石召唤着那些配得上的人，并将其礼物赠予其主体，打算在这个饱受战争蹂躏的世界中扩张其征服之地。被选中是一种荣誉勋章，向任何可能反对他们的人灌输恐惧。
universes.descriptionEn: Scattered across the globe, the God Weapons morphed society into one driven by power. These sentient monuments call to those who are worthy and bestow their gifts upon their subjects, aiming to expand their conquest in this war-torn world. To be chosen is a badge of honor, instilling fear into any who may oppose them.

nameZh: 幻灵蝙蝠 霞 梦幻强袭

nameZh: 星之守护者 阿卡丽 未来之光

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

skinNameZh: 星之守护者 阿卡丽

nameZh: SKT T1 辛德拉 至强

skinSets.descriptionZh: 恭喜2016年全球总决赛冠军：SK Telecom T1！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2016: SK Telecom T1!

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: 殿堂传奇 乐芙兰 至强

skinSets.descriptionZh: 从前，众神将他们的力量封存在四块屹世晶片中：混沌、和谐、隐忍、活力。晶片的神力会向来访的勇士发出凶险的试炼，同时应允他们铭志不朽。时至今日，各路豪杰纷纷前来挑战，只为留下一段人神共赏的传奇。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, gods of myth sealed their strength within the four Shards of the Risen: Chaos, Harmony, Patience, and Vigor. Each presented a life-threatening trial to warriors who sought its power, promising to immortalize them in history. To this day, fighters across the land rise to the challenge in hopes of leaving a legacy that even a god will respect.

universes.descriptionZh: 为了避免被永远从历史中抹去，许多人冒着生命危险成为“殿堂传奇”——一位受到这个世界的创世神们认可的勇士。那些成功的人被赋予了深不可测的力量，并被委托代表那些选择他们的神。
universes.descriptionEn: To avoid being erased from history forever, many risk their lives to become a Risen Legend—a warrior recognized by the gods who birthed this world. Those who succeed are bestowed with unfathomable power and entrusted to represent the gods that chose them.

nameZh: 殿堂传奇 乐芙兰 登神

skinSets.descriptionZh: 从前，众神将他们的力量封存在四块屹世晶片中：混沌、和谐、隐忍、活力。晶片的神力会向来访的勇士发出凶险的试炼，同时应允他们铭志不朽。时至今日，各路豪杰纷纷前来挑战，只为留下一段人神共赏的传奇。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, gods of myth sealed their strength within the four Shards of the Risen: Chaos, Harmony, Patience, and Vigor. Each presented a life-threatening trial to warriors who sought its power, promising to immortalize them in history. To this day, fighters across the land rise to the challenge in hopes of leaving a legacy that even a god will respect.

universes.descriptionZh: 为了避免被永远从历史中抹去，许多人冒着生命危险成为“殿堂传奇”——一位受到这个世界的创世神们认可的勇士。那些成功的人被赋予了深不可测的力量，并被委托代表那些选择他们的神。
universes.descriptionEn: To avoid being erased from history forever, many risk their lives to become a Risen Legend—a warrior recognized by the gods who birthed this world. Those who succeed are bestowed with unfathomable power and entrusted to represent the gods that chose them.

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 拉克丝 幻之魂焰

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 春晖神女 艾希 玉露金风

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 魅惑女巫 迦娜 炫金

skinSets.descriptionZh: 谁说女巫们不能嬉闹？不管是谁，那家伙现在可能是一只青蛙了。或是其他一些被诅咒的害虫，注定永远在街上徘徊，从远处观看庆典前夜的庆祝活动。相当严厉的惩罚，但你在期待什么？ 她们可能知道如何举办派对，但到了晚上，她们仍然是女巫！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Who said witches can't have fun? Whoever it was, they're probably a frog now. Or some other cursed vermin, doomed to forever wander the streets, watching the eve's celebrations from afar. Pretty harsh punishment, but what did you expect? They may know how to throw a party, but at the end of the night, they're still witches!

universes.descriptionZh: 父母们在他们的孩子们讲述着关于邪恶女巫之类的故事：她们每年都会有一个晚上潜伏在街道之中。 “待在床上，小家伙，因为黑暗是她们的朋友。” 这些故事只有一部分是真的；虽然这个迷人夜晚的食尸鬼喜欢吓人，但他们绝不会伤害孩子的一根头发。那些特别淘气的除外。
universes.descriptionEn: Parents tell their children stories of wicked witches and the like, those that lurk the streets one night each year. "Stay in your bed, little one, for darkness is their friend." These tales are only partly true; while the ghouls of this enchanted evening love a good scare, they'd never harm a hair on a child's head. Except for the very naughty ones.

nameZh: 青花瓷 艾瑞莉娅 金辉玉洁
heroNameZh: 刀锋舞者 艾瑞莉娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 格温 酒醉樱桃

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 青花瓷 德莱厄斯 金辉玉洁
heroNameZh: 诺克萨斯之手 德莱厄斯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。

nameZh: 星之守护者 阿卡丽 热情之光

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

skinNameZh: 星之守护者 阿卡丽

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 拉克丝 无限斗志

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！

nameZh: 战斗学院 盖伦 不死鸟
heroNameZh: 德玛西亚之力 盖伦

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在这些院校中，只有强者才能生存。尽管它们的成立是为了纪念它们的神之武器，但每个学院的学生都在通往荣耀的道路上努力使它的力量成为自己的力量。无论它是在课堂，还是在战场，都在主导着竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 散布在全球各地的神之武器将社会变成了一个由力量驱动的社会。这些有感知力的碑石召唤着那些配得上的人，并将其礼物赠予其主体，打算在这个饱受战争蹂躏的世界中扩张其征服之地。被选中是一种荣誉勋章，向任何可能反对他们的人灌输恐惧。
universes.descriptionEn: Scattered across the globe, the God Weapons morphed society into one driven by power. These sentient monuments call to those who are worthy and bestow their gifts upon their subjects, aiming to expand their conquest in this war-torn world. To be chosen is a badge of honor, instilling fear into any who may oppose them.

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 波比 焦糖布丁

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 魔女 娜美 饕餮

skinSets.descriptionZh: 女巫们蛰伏以待，一个充满了骇人美貌的姐妹会，她们的希望从不再神圣的双唇中低语而出。她们谈到了古神们的膨胀尸体，谈到了用人类早已遗忘的魔法进行的古老仪式，谈到了她们所谓的“秩序”的回归，但也有人称之为“苦难”。听！人类的末日即将来临。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The witches lay in wait, a sisterhood of frightening pulchritude, their hopes whispered forth from desacralized lips. They speak of the bloating corpses of Old Gods, of ancient rites carried out with magics long forgotten to mortal mind, of the return of what they call "order", but others call "suffering". Hark! Mankind's end fast approaches.

universes.descriptionZh: 起初，古神们统治着世界。人类对他们的爱是如此之大，以至于某个古神敢于让他们永远成为她肉体的一部分。她吞噬了太阳本身，并从那空无的天堂降临，激励她的骑士们消灭所有剩下的人。几个世纪后，他们屹立不倒，成为对抗崛起的魔女团之暗的唯一希望。
universes.descriptionEn: In the beginning, the Old Gods reigned. So great was humankind's love for them that one dared to make them a part of her flesh forever. She devoured the sun itself and, descending from that empty heaven, inspired her knights to decimate all those that remained. Centuries later, they stand, the only hope against the rising Coven's darkness.

nameZh: 魔女 辛德拉 饕餮

nameZh: 花仙子 拉克丝 蓝闪

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有花仙贵族都是自然意志的仆人，用他们的魔法实行自然的秩序和四季的更替。然而，在那个更高的目标之下，在满是丝绸、薄纱和黄金的各个奢华王庭之中，政治阴谋的游戏不断上演。 毕竟，权能——不管是魔法的、自然的还是政治的——总会激发竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: All fae nobility are servants to nature's will, carrying out the natural order and the turning of seasons with their magic. Beneath that higher purpose, however, a constant game of political intrigue plays out in luxurious courts of silk, gossamer, and gold. Power, after all—magical, natural, or political—always inspires competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 各式各样的花仙与林精都把各个花仙王国称为家园：所有由纯粹自然魔法和空灵之美组成的生物都喜欢月光狂欢、悦耳歌声、以及诡计多端的交易。
universes.descriptionEn: Pixies, nixies, hobs, redcaps, and more call the Faerie Queendoms home: all creatures of pure natural magic and ethereal beauty that delight in moonlight revels, mellifluous song, and tricksy dealings.

nameZh: 黎明使者 薇恩 虹辉

skinSets.descriptionZh: 黑夜使者和黎明使者之间的冲突是永恒的。一方面，混沌和黑暗的力量带来了改变，而另一方面，秩序和光明的力量带来了结构。正是这些神和他们的后裔塑造了一个新生的世界，而谁也说不准未来到底会带来更光明的白昼……还是更黑暗的黑夜。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Timeless is the conflict between the Nightbringers and Dawnbringers. On one side, the forces of chaos and darkness bring change, while on the other, the forces of order and light bring structure. It is these gods and their descendents that shape a nascent world, and who can say whether the future will yield brighter days... or darker nights.

universes.descriptionZh: 万物生于冲突；没有什么能逃离它。和谐是一种幻觉，只有拥抱这种幻觉的那些人才能收获人生最伟大的各种回报。
universes.descriptionEn: All things are born from conflict; none can escape it. Harmony is an illusion, and only those who embrace that illusion will reap life's greatest rewards.

nameZh: 战斗学院 卡特琳娜 盛典礼服
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在这些院校中，只有强者才能生存。尽管它们的成立是为了纪念它们的神之武器，但每个学院的学生都在通往荣耀的道路上努力使它的力量成为自己的力量。无论它是在课堂，还是在战场，都在主导着竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 散布在全球各地的神之武器将社会变成了一个由力量驱动的社会。这些有感知力的碑石召唤着那些配得上的人，并将其礼物赠予其主体，打算在这个饱受战争蹂躏的世界中扩张其征服之地。被选中是一种荣誉勋章，向任何可能反对他们的人灌输恐惧。
universes.descriptionEn: Scattered across the globe, the God Weapons morphed society into one driven by power. These sentient monuments call to those who are worthy and bestow their gifts upon their subjects, aiming to expand their conquest in this war-torn world. To be chosen is a badge of honor, instilling fear into any who may oppose them.

skinNameZh: 战斗学院 卡特琳娜

nameZh: 银龙裁决 泰隆 潜龙在渊

skinSets.descriptionZh: 三大帝国争夺土地和权力，全力以赴地备战。大军将会交锋。英雄将会崛起。传奇将会诞生。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Three great empires vie for land and power, bringing their all to bear in a test of martial might. Armies will clash. Heroes will rise. Legends will be made.

universes.descriptionZh: 帝国正在试图重组分裂的城邦，与此同时勇敢的战士和坚韧的将军正在疆场证明自己的价值。这是一个充满战争的时代，也是一个英杰辈出的时代。
universes.descriptionEn: Rival empires vie for power as they attempt to unify the lands, while brave warriors and stoic generals test their skill against the greatest heroes of the era. It is a time of war, and a time of legends.

nameZh: 星之守护者 娑娜 未来之光

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

nameZh: 星之守护者 奥莉安娜 未来之光
heroNameZh: 发条魔灵 奥莉安娜

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。

nameZh: 墨之影武者 永恩 云墨漾影

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在拉巴登城的郊外，一座破旧的神庙里居住着拉巴登人民最后的希望：墨之影武者们。他们每个人都牺牲了对他们来说最重要的东西，以便与远古灵体们签订一个契约，而这些远古灵体们为他们灌注了如此强大的魔法墨纹，以至于就连卡勃尔派也在颤抖。他们不再是无助者了。是时候收复他们的家园了。
skinSets.descriptionEn: On the outskirts of Rabadon City, a dilapidated temple houses the last hope for Rabadon's people: the Inkshadow Warriors. Each one sacrifices what is most important to them in order to make a contract with ancient spirits, who imbue them with magic tattoos so powerful, even the Cabal trembles. They are victims no more. It is time to take back their home.

universes.descriptionZh: 拉巴登城因魔法而繁荣。谁控制了魔法，谁就控制了拉巴登。而阴谋集团的控制是绝对的。任何反抗者都会被制服或被消灭……但义军即将来临。这些反抗者们所倚仗的武器是他们皮肤上直接绘制的危险魔法墨纹，而他们的目标是推翻卡勃尔派并将这座城市还给它的人民——不成功，便成仁。
universes.descriptionEn: Rabadon City thrives on magic. Whoever controls magic, controls Rabadon. And the Cabal's control is absolute. Any who resist are brought to heel or eliminated… but an Uprising is coming. Armed with dangerous magic inked directly into their skin, these rebels seek to topple the Cabal and give the city back to its people—or die trying.

nameZh: 墨之影武者 亚索 金墨耀影

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在拉巴登城的郊外，一座破旧的神庙里居住着拉巴登人民最后的希望：墨之影武者们。他们每个人都牺牲了对他们来说最重要的东西，以便与远古灵体们签订一个契约，而这些远古灵体们为他们灌注了如此强大的魔法墨纹，以至于就连卡勃尔派也在颤抖。他们不再是无助者了。是时候收复他们的家园了。

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 格温 幻之魂焰

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 2023 全球总决赛 雷克顿 潜力解封
heroNameEn: the Butcher of the Sands Renekton

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有游戏中最伟大的舞台。两支队伍在数百万粉丝面前对决。只有一支队伍会被加冕为冠军。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

skinNameZh: 2023 全球总决赛 雷克顿

nameZh: 天龙之子 黛安娜 云起龙骧

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 青花瓷 厄运小姐 金辉玉洁
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 净雪之月 莫甘娜 冬虹

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当净雪之月升到艾欧尼亚令人谦卑的群山上方时，一股寒意掠过大地。敬奉它之名的那些人——一个由坚定的刺客们组成的教派——开始了他们的仪式。伴随着净雪而来的是净化，一种只有通过牺牲人性才能实现的净化。
skinSets.descriptionEn: As the Snow Moon rises beyond the humbling mountains of Ionia, a chill passes across the land. Those who worship in its name—a cult of unwavering assassins—commence their ritual. With snow comes purification, a cleansing only possible through the sacrifice of one's humanity.

universes.descriptionZh: 一个声音从寂静中回响：“翻腾吧，野兽们，教友们。艾欧尼亚在劫难逃，它的诸多月亮像饥饿的恶魔的眼睛一样升起，等待着你们忠诚的红色——抑或它们是无法越过的可怕荒芜？ 无论是哪种方式，我们都是沉浸在仪式和献祭中的躯壳。在月亮的顶峰，我们从肉中切肉，献上微薄的礼物——我们自身的一切。”
universes.descriptionEn: A voice echoes from the silence: “Writhe, beasts, brethren. The moons of a doomed Ionia rise like eyes of starved demons, awaiting the red of your fealty—or are they monstrous blights that cannot pass? Either way, we are vessels plunged in ritual and sacrifice. At the moon's peak, we carve flesh from flesh, offering the meager gift of all that we are.”

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 伊芙琳 毅之魂焰

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 玉剑传说 舞剑仙 空翠烟霏
heroNameZh: 刀锋舞者 艾瑞莉娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 心之钢 永恩 金声玉振

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 玉剑传说 无劫 胭脂

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
