nameZh: 咖啡甜心 金克丝 核桃巴菲

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 墨之影武者 卡莎 金墨耀影

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在拉巴登城的郊外，一座破旧的神庙里居住着拉巴登人民最后的希望：墨之影武者们。他们每个人都牺牲了对他们来说最重要的东西，以便与远古灵体们签订一个契约，而这些远古灵体们为他们灌注了如此强大的魔法墨纹，以至于就连卡勃尔派也在颤抖。他们不再是无助者了。是时候收复他们的家园了。
skinSets.descriptionEn: On the outskirts of Rabadon City, a dilapidated temple houses the last hope for Rabadon's people: the Inkshadow Warriors. Each one sacrifices what is most important to them in order to make a contract with ancient spirits, who imbue them with magic tattoos so powerful, even the Cabal trembles. They are victims no more. It is time to take back their home.

universes.descriptionZh: 拉巴登城因魔法而繁荣。谁控制了魔法，谁就控制了拉巴登。而阴谋集团的控制是绝对的。任何反抗者都会被制服或被消灭……但义军即将来临。这些反抗者们所倚仗的武器是他们皮肤上直接绘制的危险魔法墨纹，而他们的目标是推翻卡勃尔派并将这座城市还给它的人民——不成功，便成仁。
universes.descriptionEn: Rabadon City thrives on magic. Whoever controls magic, controls Rabadon. And the Cabal's control is absolute. Any who resist are brought to heel or eliminated… but an Uprising is coming. Armed with dangerous magic inked directly into their skin, these rebels seek to topple the Cabal and give the city back to its people—or die trying.

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 璐璐 焦糖布丁

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 神龙尊者 圣龙李青 登龙

skinSets.descriptionZh: 尊荣的巨龙们居住在偏远的雄奇瑰丽之地，为了避免外面的凡界纷争，它们只会非常罕见地将礼物赐给极少数被它们选中的人。神龙尊者们就是幸运且强大到足以获得这种终极赐福的人。他们用它来行善还是行恶，都取决于他们自己，以及任何强大到足以制止他们的人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Majestic dragons dwell in remote places of wild beauty, avoiding mortal affairs outside of rarely bestowing their gifts on only a select few. The Dragonmancers are those fortunate and powerful enough to have gained the ultimate blessing. Whether they then use that for good or for evil is up to them, and anyone strong enough to stop them.

universes.descriptionZh: 圣兽们守护着整个世界，能够把任何人变成强大的存在，但前提是那个灵魂值得他们的祝福。无论他们的力量是用于善还是恶，一旦赐予，就无法收回。
universes.descriptionEn: Divine beasts watch over the world entire, capable of turning anyone into powerful beings, but only if that soul is worthy of their blessings. Whether their power is used for good or evil, once the gift is given, it cannot be taken away.

skinNameZh: 神龙尊者 圣龙李青

nameZh: 征服者 韦鲁斯 炫金

skinSets.descriptionZh: 纪念《英雄联盟》季中冠军赛和春季赛。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Commemorating the League of Legends Mid-Season Invitational and Spring Split tournaments.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: 幻灵战斗猫 金克丝 梦幻强袭

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 幻灵战斗猫 金克丝

nameZh: 星之守护者 辛德拉 未来之光

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第二季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 资深星之守护者阿狸和厄运小姐突然重新出现在瓦罗兰城。她们的前一支小队已在一场未知事件中被摧毁，而她们正是来此重建团队。为了打破每一位已宣誓的星之守护者的宿命，她们在虚空野兽降临这座城市时与拉克丝等人一起加入战斗。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Veteran Star Guardians Ahri and Miss Fortune suddenly reappear in Valoran City, having rebuilt their team after an unknown event destroyed their previous squad. Seeking to defy the destiny of every Star Guardian who takes up the oath, they join the fight alongside Lux and company as Void Beasts descend upon the city.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

skinNameZh: 星之守护者 辛德拉

nameZh: 神龙之翼 库奇 飞龙腾云

skinSets.descriptionZh: 春节到了——派对也到了！家人朋友聚在一起，共同享用美食与佳节时光。现在，点燃一根火柴，然后观看焰火吧！
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Lunar New Year has arrived—and so has the party! With food and festivities to spare, it's all about ringing it in with friends and family. Now strike up a match and watch the fireworks!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 天龙之子 卡莎 云起龙骧

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。

nameZh: 玉剑传说 翼剑仙 珠光

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

nameZh: 星之守护者 金克丝 黑洞

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第一季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 高中生拉克丝和她的星之守护者小队获得了始源之星的神奇力量，秘密地保护世界免受星际怪物的侵害。但是谁来保护他们免受瓦洛兰城高中的戏剧性影响呢？
skinSets.descriptionEn: Magically empowered by the First Star, high schooler Lux and her team of Star Guardians secretly protect the world from interstellar monsters. But who will protect them from the drama of Valoran City High?

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。

nameZh: 南天之怒 沃里克 炫金天神
heroNameEn: the Uncaged Wrath of Zaun Warwick

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。

nameZh: 净雪之月 阿狸 水竹

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当净雪之月升到艾欧尼亚令人谦卑的群山上方时，一股寒意掠过大地。敬奉它之名的那些人——一个由坚定的刺客们组成的教派——开始了他们的仪式。伴随着净雪而来的是净化，一种只有通过牺牲人性才能实现的净化。
skinSets.descriptionEn: As the Snow Moon rises beyond the humbling mountains of Ionia, a chill passes across the land. Those who worship in its name—a cult of unwavering assassins—commence their ritual. With snow comes purification, a cleansing only possible through the sacrifice of one's humanity.

universes.descriptionZh: 一个声音从寂静中回响：“翻腾吧，野兽们，教友们。艾欧尼亚在劫难逃，它的诸多月亮像饥饿的恶魔的眼睛一样升起，等待着你们忠诚的红色——抑或它们是无法越过的可怕荒芜？ 无论是哪种方式，我们都是沉浸在仪式和献祭中的躯壳。在月亮的顶峰，我们从肉中切肉，献上微薄的礼物——我们自身的一切。”
universes.descriptionEn: A voice echoes from the silence: “Writhe, beasts, brethren. The moons of a doomed Ionia rise like eyes of starved demons, awaiting the red of your fealty—or are they monstrous blights that cannot pass? Either way, we are vessels plunged in ritual and sacrifice. At the moon's peak, we carve flesh from flesh, offering the meager gift of all that we are.”

nameZh: 冠军之志 瑞兹 凯旋圣装

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有游戏中最伟大的舞台。两支队伍在数百万粉丝面前对决。只有一支队伍会被加冕为冠军。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

heroNameZh: 弗雷尔卓德之心 布隆
heroNameEn: the Heart of the Freljord Braum

skinSets.descriptionZh: 世界已经被巨龙之火吞噬过两次，被铸造英雄的余烬毁灭过两次。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Twice did dragonfire consume the world. Twice from the embers were heroes forged.

universes.descriptionZh: 世界已经被巨龙之火吞噬过两次，被铸造英雄的余烬毁灭过两次。
universes.descriptionEn: Twice did dragonfire consume the world. Twice from the embers were heroes forged.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 亚索 霜见

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 可爱可爱粉红红 布里茨
heroNameZh: 蒸汽机器人 布里茨

skinSets.descriptionZh: 嗡。嗡嗡嗡。嗡，嗡，嗡嗡嗡。嗡……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Bzzz. Bzzz bzzz bzzz. Bzzz! Bzzz, bzz, bzz bzz bzz. Bzzz...

universes.descriptionZh: 嗡。嗡嗡嗡。嗡，嗡，嗡嗡嗡。嗡……
universes.descriptionEn: Bzzz. Bzzz bzzz bzzz. Bzzz! Bzzz, bzz, bzz bzz bzz. Bzzz...

nameZh: 幻灵战斗队长 厄运小姐 勇气赞歌
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 幻灵战斗队长 厄运小姐

nameZh: 冠军之隐 劫 凯旋圣装

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有游戏中最伟大的舞台。两支队伍在数百万粉丝面前对决。只有一支队伍会被加冕为冠军。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: 心之钢 伊泽瑞尔 金声玉振

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 持七彩冰棍的雪人 易

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在神奇的冬季仙境中，魄罗王之的统治至高无上，向他王庭的所有人传播欢乐和喜悦。尽管其他人都想篡夺国王的王位，但他们都对冬境仙灵们有着共同的热爱。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Within the magical Winterlands, the Poro King reigns supreme, spreading joy and merriment to all of his court. Even as others work to usurp the king, all share a common love for winter's wonders.

universes.descriptionZh: 一年中还有比空气清新、雪花蓬松、巧克力热腾腾的冰雪节更好的时候吗？投掷雪球或吟唱颂歌；只要你怀着好心情，一切都会好起来的，然后你就没有什么好怕的了。
universes.descriptionEn: Is there a better time of year than Snowdown, when the air is crisp, the snow fluffy, and the chocolate hot? Toss a snowball or sing a carol; as long as you have good cheer, all will be well, and you'll have nothing to fear.

skinNameZh: 持胡萝卜的雪人 易

nameZh: 最终BOSS 维迦 里・大魔王
heroNameEn: the Tiny Master of Evil Veigar

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在电玩迪亚的服务器深处存在着一系列被所有玩家称为“战斗BOSS”的邪恶故障。他们的受损代码给他们带来了新的自由……但也带来了新的挑战。为了完成他们对电玩世界的删除，许多BOSS同意搁置他们的分歧(直到……不便透露)。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Deep within Arcadia's servers lies a sinister series of glitches known to all gamers as the Battle Bosses. Their corrupted code has brought them newfound freedom… but also new challengers. To complete their deletion of the Arcade World, many of the Bosses have agreed to put aside their differences (until it's… inconvenient).

universes.descriptionZh: 在屏幕上闪烁的“投币开玩”，对任何称职的玩家来说都是一种不可抗拒的提议。但是，当他们从简陋的街机游戏厅抽离，投入到英雄和战场BOSS的世界时，这些平平无奇的玩家将不得不凭借他们所具备的全部反应力和连招来进行战斗。因为电玩世界的玩家们……是用命在玩。
universes.descriptionEn: Insert Coin to Play" flashes on the screen, an irrestistable offer for any gamer worth their salt. But whisked away from their humble arcade into a world of Heroes and Battle Bosses, these ordinary players will have to fight with all the reflexes and combos they can muster. Because gamers in Arcadia... are playing with their lives.

nameZh: 玉剑传说 寒潭夭夭 胭脂

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

skinNameZh: 玉剑传说 寒潭夭夭

nameZh: 破败军团 厄运小姐 灵岛征伐使
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

skinSets.descriptionZh: 蚀魂夜将它的黑雾散布在符文大地，肆意地腐蚀着。有些人，在它的影响下，受到了动摇并追随了破败之王，从而相信他们的目标一致。但是佛耶戈只想要伊苏尔德回来；他没有任何盟友。帮助他阻止光明哨兵们的破败军团们只不过是一个心碎情种的游戏中的棋子。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Harrowing spreads its Black Mist across Runeterra, corrupting indiscriminately. Some, in its presence, are swayed to follow the Ruined King, believing their goals aligned. But Viego wants only the return of Isolde; he has no allies. The Ruined who aid him in halting the Sentinels are mere pawns in a broken-hearted lover's game.

universes.descriptionZh: 黑雾聚集，蚀魂夜到来，并且破败之王已经再次崛起。佛耶戈的腐败席卷了符文之地，将好友变为仇敌并使诸国屈服。仅有的有能力阻挡他的一群人，就是光明哨兵：一个由赛娜和卢锡安领导的古老教团。他们必须从全境的每个角落将英雄们召集起来，以对黑雾进行反击并一劳永逸地终结破败之王的恐怖统治。
universes.descriptionEn: The Black Mist gathers, the Harrowing comes, and the Ruined King has risen once more. Viego's corruption blankets Runeterra, turning friends into foes and bringing entire nations to their knees. The only ones with the power to stop him are the Sentinels of Light: an ancient order led by Senna and Lucian. They must call upon champions from every corner of the realm to fight back the Black Mist and end the Ruined King's reign of terror once and for all.

skinNameZh: 破败军团 厄运小姐

nameZh: 冠军之矛 卡莉丝塔 凯旋圣装
heroNameZh: 复仇之矛 卡莉丝塔

nameZh: 霸天异形 卡兹克 刹那银光
heroNameZh: 虚空掠夺者 卡兹克

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当身形庞大的怪兽开始从海中、地上和空中发起进攻时，人类发展出了相同威力的霸天机甲单位以爆发性的徒手战斗抵御它们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When colossal kaiju begin attacking from the sea, land, and air, humanity develops equally powerful mecha units to stop them in explosive hand-to-hand combat.

universes.descriptionZh: 耸立在城市之上，庞大的怪兽与高耸的机甲扭打在一起。谁会赢？
universes.descriptionEn: Towering above the city, gargantuan kaiju tussle with towering mechas. Who will win?

nameZh: 偶像歌手 阿狸 高山杜鹃

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当你在排行榜的顶端时，没有人能把你打下来。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When you're at the top of the charts, no one can bring you down.

nameZh: 闭月之颜 貂蝉 炫金莲华
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

skinSets.descriptionZh: 三大帝国争夺土地和权力，全力以赴地备战。大军将会交锋。英雄将会崛起。传奇将会诞生。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Three great empires vie for land and power, bringing their all to bear in a test of martial might. Armies will clash. Heroes will rise. Legends will be made.

universes.descriptionZh: 帝国正在试图重组分裂的城邦，与此同时勇敢的战士和坚韧的将军正在疆场证明自己的价值。这是一个充满战争的时代，也是一个英杰辈出的时代。
universes.descriptionEn: Rival empires vie for power as they attempt to unify the lands, while brave warriors and stoic generals test their skill against the greatest heroes of the era. It is a time of war, and a time of legends.

nameZh: 玄晖霓裳 嫦娥

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 卡西奥佩娅 流火
heroNameZh: 魔蛇之拥 卡西奥佩娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 星之守护者 卡莎 热情之光

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

nameZh: 星之守护者 霞 烈羽

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第三季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 阿狸从前的小队重新露面，曾经将他们撕裂的事件已经将他们改变……并且随之而来的是星之守护者从未面临过的威胁。这个团队是放下旧怨并使自身免于毁灭呢？还是将成为暮光之星的下一批受害者呢？
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ahri's old squad resurfaces, changed from the events that once tore them apart... and followed by a threat beyond anything the Star Guardians have ever faced. Can the group move past old grudges and save themselves from annihilation? Or will they simply be the next victims of the Twilight Star?

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

nameZh: 无畏竞巅峰 薇恩

skinSets.descriptionZh: 灵魂就是生命、光明和力量——并且在一个没有慈悲的世界里，它们被无情的死亡之主们偷走并吞噬。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Souls are life, light, power—and in a world without mercy, they are stolen and consumed by remorseless masters of death.

universes.descriptionZh: 灵魂就是生命、光明和力量——并且在一个没有慈悲的世界里，它们被无情的死亡之主们偷走并吞噬。
universes.descriptionEn: Souls are life, light, power—and in a world without mercy, they are stolen and consumed by remorseless masters of death.

nameZh: 巅峰剑仙 菲奥娜 天神下凡

skinSets.descriptionZh: 恭喜2018年全球总决赛冠军：Invictus Gaming！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2018: Invictus Gaming!

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: 巅峰之拳 瑟提 明镜止水

skinSets.descriptionZh: 尊荣的巨龙们居住在偏远的雄奇瑰丽之地，为了避免外面的凡界纷争，它们只会非常罕见地将礼物赐给极少数被它们选中的人。神龙尊者们就是幸运且强大到足以获得这种终极赐福的人。他们用它来行善还是行恶，都取决于他们自己，以及任何强大到足以制止他们的人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Majestic dragons dwell in remote places of wild beauty, avoiding mortal affairs outside of rarely bestowing their gifts on only a select few. The Dragonmancers are those fortunate and powerful enough to have gained the ultimate blessing. Whether they then use that for good or for evil is up to them, and anyone strong enough to stop them.

universes.descriptionZh: 圣兽们守护着整个世界，能够把任何人变成强大的存在，但前提是那个灵魂值得他们的祝福。无论他们的力量是用于善还是恶，一旦赐予，就无法收回。
universes.descriptionEn: Divine beasts watch over the world entire, capable of turning anyone into powerful beings, but only if that soul is worthy of their blessings. Whether their power is used for good or evil, once the gift is given, it cannot be taken away.

skinNameZh: 神龙尊者 炎龙瑟提

nameZh: 无畏游侠 卢锡安 不败圣枪

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

nameZh: 无畏骑士 瑟庄妮 赤子初心

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在神奇的冬季仙境中，魄罗王之的统治至高无上，向他王庭的所有人传播欢乐和喜悦。尽管其他人都想篡夺国王的王位，但他们都对冬境仙灵们有着共同的热爱。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Within the magical Winterlands, the Poro King reigns supreme, spreading joy and merriment to all of his court. Even as others work to usurp the king, all share a common love for winter's wonders.

universes.descriptionZh: 一年中还有比空气清新、雪花蓬松、巧克力热腾腾的冰雪节更好的时候吗？投掷雪球或吟唱颂歌；只要你怀着好心情，一切都会好起来的，然后你就没有什么好怕的了。
universes.descriptionEn: Is there a better time of year than Snowdown, when the air is crisp, the snow fluffy, and the chocolate hot? Toss a snowball or sing a carol; as long as you have good cheer, all will be well, and you'll have nothing to fear.

nameZh: 无畏意志 墨菲特 必不可挡

skinSets.descriptionZh: 恭喜2019年全球总决赛冠军：FunPlus Phoenix！

nameZh: 春晖神女 拉克丝 流风回雪

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有游戏中最伟大的舞台。两支队伍在数百万粉丝面前对决。只有一支队伍会被加冕为冠军。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

nameZh: 冰雪游神 巴德 炫金

skinSets.descriptionZh: 冰雪佳节将来到，三条战线雪飘飘……\n坦克冲锋吹号角，恰逢上路来得妙，\n金币满满口袋饱，巫妖之祸任逍遥......
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's beginning to look a lot like Snow Day, up and down the lanes... \nThough your tank may be rushing in, Top is backing again, \nThey have gold to spend on a Lich Bane...

universes.descriptionZh: 一年中还有比空气清新、雪花蓬松、巧克力热腾腾的冰雪节更好的时候吗？投掷雪球或吟唱颂歌；只要你怀着好心情，一切都会好起来的，然后你就没有什么好怕的了。

nameZh: 社会名流 乐芙兰 紫罗兰魅影

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这就是一门生计！
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's a living!

universes.descriptionZh: 磨砺之路不仅仅是工作。它是斗争，是喧嚣，有时令人振奋，有时令人沮丧。它是一个为期一周的过山车，有喜剧性的过弯和悲惨的急落，只会在周一重新开始。我们是努力工作还是几乎不工作？在磨砺之路上，一切都一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The grind isn't just work. It's the struggle, the hustle, sometimes invigorating, sometimes demoralizing. It's a weeklong rollercoaster with comedic bends and tragic drops, only to start all over again on Monday. Are we working hard or hardly working? It's all the same on the grind.

nameZh: 星之吞噬者 莫甘娜 热情之末

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

skinNameZh: 星之吞噬者 莫甘娜

nameZh: 幻灵战斗兔 锐雯 梦幻强袭

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

nameZh: 怦然心动 凯特琳 未相见心已至

skinSets.descriptionZh: 洋溢着学院风且风度翩翩的心动派与宁愿逃课去滑板场闲逛的心伤组没有太多共同之处。但他们在一件事上达成了一致：他们已经受够了这个为了人们萌生感情而硬造出来的愚蠢节日。那么，为什么他们似乎无法摆脱这种小鹿乱撞的感觉呢？
skinSets.descriptionEn: The preppy and perfectly poised Heartthrob clique don't have much in common with the Heartache crew, who would much rather be ditching class to hang out at the skatepark. But they agree on one thing: they've had it with this silly made up holiday dedicated to people catching feelings. So why can't they seem to shake the butterflies from their stomachs?

universes.descriptionZh: 在刻板的小团体、尴尬的小组项目和俗气的假日之间，校园生活枯燥且乏味。但坠入爱河并不在教学大纲里，并且它会让事情变得更复杂。
universes.descriptionEn: Between the rigid cliques, awkward group projects, and cheesy holidays, school was rough but routine. But getting lovestruck wasn't in the syllabus, and it's gonna make things way more complicated.

nameZh: 泳池派对 凯特琳 粉红冰川

skinSets.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

universes.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
universes.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 觅心萝莉 金克丝 是心动啊

skinSets.descriptionZh: 大多数人都在安静的公园或友好的茶馆里寻找恋人。但那些关系不会长久。在战场上形成的各种纽带，就像直接穿过敌人心脏的子弹一样具有穿透力……才是能够持续下去的关系。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Most seek out sweethearts in quiet parks or friendly tea shops. But those relationships never last. The bonds formed on the battlefield, piercing like bullets straight through the hearts of enemies... those endure.

universes.descriptionZh: 所以……你愿意吗？
universes.descriptionEn: So... will you?

universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: 山海绘卷 科加斯 朱红
heroNameEn: the Terror of the Void Cho'Gath

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在传说中的山海绘卷中，神明们和神话生物们在各个神奇的土地上游荡，挥舞着元素的力量。有些人满足于接受给定的调色板，而另一些人则希望跳出界限，用一支新的画笔描绘他们的生活。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Within the fabled Shan Hai Scrolls, gods and mythical creatures roam magical lands, wielding the power of the elements. Some are content to live with the palette they've been given, while others wish to jump beyond the borders and paint their lives with a new brush.

universes.descriptionZh: 没有人能说出神秘的山海绘卷是何人或在何时创作的。只需要一眼就可以看出这幅画是通向魔法和奇迹世界的一扇窗户，但也许它更像是一扇门扉？
universes.descriptionEn: No one can say who created the mysterious Shan Hai Scrolls, or when. All it takes is one glimpse to see the painting is a window to a world of magic and wonder, but perhaps it is more of a doorway?

nameZh: 泳池派对 辛德拉 荔枝枝连击

skinSets.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 霸天巨兽·雪崩 墨菲特

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当身形庞大的怪兽开始从海中、地上和空中发起进攻时，人类发展出了相同威力的霸天机甲单位以爆发性的徒手战斗抵御它们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When colossal kaiju begin attacking from the sea, land, and air, humanity develops equally powerful mecha units to stop them in explosive hand-to-hand combat.

universes.descriptionZh: 耸立在城市之上，庞大的怪兽与高耸的机甲扭打在一起。谁会赢？
universes.descriptionEn: Towering above the city, gargantuan kaiju tussle with towering mechas. Who will win?

nameZh: 源计划：火 菲奥娜 惩戒

skinSets.descriptionZh: 源计划集团相信解开人类潜能的秘密是超越我们凡躯的关键。我们将通过技术达到飞升。聚在一起。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The PROJECT Corporation believes unlocking the secrets of humanity's potential is the key to progress beyond our mortal bodies. It is through technology that we will ascend. Together.

universes.descriptionZh: 在某个由数个全球集团所控制的未来，巨型建筑物和拥挤的街道之中，一场暗影战争在充满抗争精神且被技术增幅过的人类和全新强化过的智能生物之间打响了。胜者将改变历史的进程……而败者将被强迫演变。
universes.descriptionEn: Among the mega-structures and packed streets of a future controlled by global corporations, a shadow war rages between rebellious, augmented humans and newly empowered artificial beings. The winners will shape the course of history... and the losers will be forced to evolve.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 薇恩 春晓

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

heroNameZh: 牛头酋长 阿利斯塔

skinSets.descriptionZh: 纪念《英雄联盟》季中冠军赛和春季赛。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Commemorating the League of Legends Mid-Season Invitational and Spring Split tournaments.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！

nameZh: 灰烬守护者 慎 余烬觉醒

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久很久以前，一位伟大的国王发动了一场光荣的战争：去打破世界上的魔法枷锁，让人类能够铸就自己的命运。然而，在切断最后的魔法源头后，国王失踪了，世界的根基崩塌了，并且他曾经传奇的骑士们被单独留给了疯狂、破败和灰烬。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Many ages long past, a great king waged a glorious war: to break the shackles of magic on the world, so that mankind could forge its own destiny. Yet upon severing the final font of enchantment, the king was lost, the foundations of the world crumbled, and his once-legendary knights were left alone to madness, ruin, and ash.

universes.descriptionZh: 当魔法消失时，取而代之的是灰烬和绝望。当那个被诅咒的教团陨落时，会取而代之的是什么呢？
universes.descriptionEn: When magic is lost, ash and despair reign in its stead. When the knights of that cursed order fall, what will rise in their place?

nameZh: 西部天使 赛娜 贝利尔之怠

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

nameZh: 弹幕天使 卡莎 炽天使·公正

skinSets.descriptionZh: 一个曾饱经战乱的星系，现在试图重建，但旧伤仍在。罪犯、赏金猎人、佣兵、以及刺客早已填满了权力的真空，用神一般的技艺驾驶着危险的战斗服。
skinSets.descriptionEn: A galaxy scarred by war now attempts to rebuild, but the old wounds remain. Criminals, bounty hunters, mercenaries, and assassins have filled the power vacuum, piloting dangerous combat exo-suits with godlike abilities.

universes.descriptionZh: 一个饱受战争摧残的星系在试图重建，但旧伤仍在。赏金猎人和企业特工早已填满了权力的真空，其中的一些人用神一般的技艺驾驶着危险的外装战斗服。作为回应，大型企业已开始利用私人军队在遥远的太空殖民地执行他们的意愿。战争永不消亡；它只是换了个战场。
universes.descriptionEn: A war-torn galaxy attempts to rebuild, but old wounds remain. Bounty hunters and corporate agents have filled the power vacuum, some piloting dangerous combat exo suits with godlike abilities. In response, megacorporations leverage private armies to enforce their will across the far-flung colonies of space. War never dies; it only changes battlefields.

nameZh: 幻灵战斗蝠 薇恩 梦幻强袭

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

nameZh: 幻灵战斗狼 塞拉斯 梦幻强袭

nameZh: 玉剑传说 无影 莫问

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 战斗学院 凯特琳 独角兽

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在这些院校中，只有强者才能生存。尽管它们的成立是为了纪念它们的神之武器，但每个学院的学生都在通往荣耀的道路上努力使它的力量成为自己的力量。无论它是在课堂，还是在战场，都在主导着竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 散布在全球各地的神之武器将社会变成了一个由力量驱动的社会。这些有感知力的碑石召唤着那些配得上的人，并将其礼物赠予其主体，打算在这个饱受战争蹂躏的世界中扩张其征服之地。被选中是一种荣誉勋章，向任何可能反对他们的人灌输恐惧。
universes.descriptionEn: Scattered across the globe, the God Weapons morphed society into one driven by power. These sentient monuments call to those who are worthy and bestow their gifts upon their subjects, aiming to expand their conquest in this war-torn world. To be chosen is a badge of honor, instilling fear into any who may oppose them.

nameZh: 源计划：毁灭 派克 幻灭

nameZh: 天煞 劫 恒星游历者

skinSets.descriptionZh: 从高度城市化的核心星球到银河系最外围的边缘，冒险故事在等待！伟大的德玛锡安帝国全然不顾古老的圣骑士团和犯罪辛迪加等势力的反对，追寻着神奇的奥能。这种金色的物质是所有文明的命脉，并能给掌握它的人带来无比的力量……
skinSets.descriptionEn: From the urbanized coreworlds to the outermost edge of the galaxy, adventure awaits! The great Demaxian Empire ignores the objections of the Templar Order and the criminal Syndicate alike in their pursuit of ora—a mysterious golden essence that serves as the lifeblood of all civilization, and promises untold power to those who can wield it for themselves…

universes.descriptionZh: 从高度城市化的核心星球到银河系最外围的边缘，冒险故事在等待！伟大的德玛锡安帝国全然不顾古老的圣骑士团和犯罪辛迪加等势力的反对，追寻着神奇的奥能。这种金色的物质是所有文明的命脉，并能给掌握它的人带来无比的力量……

The great Demaxian Empire ignores the objections of the Templar Order and the criminal Syndicate alike in their pursuit of ora—a mysterious golden essence that serves as the lifeblood of all civilization, and promises untold power to those who can wield it for themselves…

nameZh: 女帝 卡特琳娜 纹章之刻印 英勇
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 阿狸 春晓

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 皓彩霓裳 嫦娥

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 冠军之箭 艾希 凯旋圣装

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有游戏中最伟大的舞台。两支队伍在数百万粉丝面前对决。只有一支队伍会被加冕为冠军。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: 冰霜之刃 艾瑞莉娅 炫金
heroNameZh: 刀锋舞者 艾瑞莉娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在神奇的冬季仙境中，魄罗王之的统治至高无上，向他王庭的所有人传播欢乐和喜悦。尽管其他人都想篡夺国王的王位，但他们都对冬境仙灵们有着共同的热爱。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Within the magical Winterlands, the Poro King reigns supreme, spreading joy and merriment to all of his court. Even as others work to usurp the king, all share a common love for winter's wonders.

universes.descriptionZh: 一年中还有比空气清新、雪花蓬松、巧克力热腾腾的冰雪节更好的时候吗？投掷雪球或吟唱颂歌；只要你怀着好心情，一切都会好起来的，然后你就没有什么好怕的了。
universes.descriptionEn: Is there a better time of year than Snowdown, when the air is crisp, the snow fluffy, and the chocolate hot? Toss a snowball or sing a carol; as long as you have good cheer, all will be well, and you'll have nothing to fear.

skinNameZh: 冰霜之刃 艾瑞莉娅

nameZh: 源计划：联合 艾希 红莲之弓

skinSets.descriptionZh: 源计划集团相信解开人类潜能的秘密是超越我们凡躯的关键。我们将通过技术达到飞升。聚在一起。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The PROJECT Corporation believes unlocking the secrets of humanity's potential is the key to progress beyond our mortal bodies. It is through technology that we will ascend. Together.

universes.descriptionZh: 在某个由数个全球集团所控制的未来，巨型建筑物和拥挤的街道之中，一场暗影战争在充满抗争精神且被技术增幅过的人类和全新强化过的智能生物之间打响了。胜者将改变历史的进程……而败者将被强迫演变。
universes.descriptionEn: Among the mega-structures and packed streets of a future controlled by global corporations, a shadow war rages between rebellious, augmented humans and newly empowered artificial beings. The winners will shape the course of history... and the losers will be forced to evolve.

nameZh: 黎明使者 锐雯 黑夜使者

skinSets.descriptionZh: 黑夜使者和黎明使者之间的冲突是永恒的。一方面，混沌和黑暗的力量带来了改变，而另一方面，秩序和光明的力量带来了结构。正是这些神和他们的后裔塑造了一个新生的世界，而谁也说不准未来到底会带来更光明的白昼……还是更黑暗的黑夜。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Timeless is the conflict between the Nightbringers and Dawnbringers. On one side, the forces of chaos and darkness bring change, while on the other, the forces of order and light bring structure. It is these gods and their descendents that shape a nascent world, and who can say whether the future will yield brighter days... or darker nights.

universes.descriptionZh: 万物生于冲突；没有什么能逃离它。和谐是一种幻觉，只有拥抱这种幻觉的那些人才能收获人生最伟大的各种回报。
universes.descriptionEn: All things are born from conflict; none can escape it. Harmony is an illusion, and only those who embrace that illusion will reap life's greatest rewards.

nameZh: 偶像歌手 阿狸 皇室鸢尾

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当你在排行榜的顶端时，没有人能把你打下来。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When you're at the top of the charts, no one can bring you down.

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 古琴余韵 娑娜 炫金天籁

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！

universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 霸天战士 雷恩加尔 星啸天火
heroNameZh: 傲之追猎者 雷恩加尔

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当身形庞大的怪兽开始从海中、地上和空中发起进攻时，人类发展出了相同威力的霸天机甲单位以爆发性的徒手战斗抵御它们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When colossal kaiju begin attacking from the sea, land, and air, humanity develops equally powerful mecha units to stop them in explosive hand-to-hand combat.

universes.descriptionZh: 耸立在城市之上，庞大的怪兽与高耸的机甲扭打在一起。谁会赢？
universes.descriptionEn: Towering above the city, gargantuan kaiju tussle with towering mechas. Who will win?

skinNameZh: 霸天战士 雷恩加尔

nameZh: 替父从军 花木兰 炫金龙刃

skinSets.descriptionZh: 三大帝国争夺土地和权力，全力以赴地备战。大军将会交锋。英雄将会崛起。传奇将会诞生。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Three great empires vie for land and power, bringing their all to bear in a test of martial might. Armies will clash. Heroes will rise. Legends will be made.

universes.descriptionZh: 帝国正在试图重组分裂的城邦，与此同时勇敢的战士和坚韧的将军正在疆场证明自己的价值。这是一个充满战争的时代，也是一个英杰辈出的时代。
universes.descriptionEn: Rival empires vie for power as they attempt to unify the lands, while brave warriors and stoic generals test their skill against the greatest heroes of the era. It is a time of war, and a time of legends.

nameZh: 弹幕天使 卡莎 炽天使·勇敢

skinSets.descriptionZh: 一个曾饱经战乱的星系，现在试图重建，但旧伤仍在。罪犯、赏金猎人、佣兵、以及刺客早已填满了权力的真空，用神一般的技艺驾驶着危险的战斗服。
skinSets.descriptionEn: A galaxy scarred by war now attempts to rebuild, but the old wounds remain. Criminals, bounty hunters, mercenaries, and assassins have filled the power vacuum, piloting dangerous combat exo-suits with godlike abilities.

universes.descriptionZh: 一个饱受战争摧残的星系在试图重建，但旧伤仍在。赏金猎人和企业特工早已填满了权力的真空，其中的一些人用神一般的技艺驾驶着危险的外装战斗服。作为回应，大型企业已开始利用私人军队在遥远的太空殖民地执行他们的意愿。战争永不消亡；它只是换了个战场。
universes.descriptionEn: A war-torn galaxy attempts to rebuild, but old wounds remain. Bounty hunters and corporate agents have filled the power vacuum, some piloting dangerous combat exo suits with godlike abilities. In response, megacorporations leverage private armies to enforce their will across the far-flung colonies of space. War never dies; it only changes battlefields.

nameZh: 玉剑传说 风仙子 毕方

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 神龙烈焰 金克丝 珍珠龙息

skinSets.descriptionZh: 春节到了——派对也到了！家人朋友聚在一起，共同享用美食与佳节时光。现在，点燃一根火柴，然后观看焰火吧！
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Lunar New Year has arrived—and so has the party! With food and festivities to spare, it's all about ringing it in with friends and family. Now strike up a match and watch the fireworks!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 雾雨之刃 锐雯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这就是一门生计！
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's a living!

universes.descriptionZh: 磨砺之路不仅仅是工作。它是斗争，是喧嚣，有时令人振奋，有时令人沮丧。它是一个为期一周的过山车，有喜剧性的过弯和悲惨的急落，只会在周一重新开始。我们是努力工作还是几乎不工作？在磨砺之路上，一切都一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The grind isn't just work. It's the struggle, the hustle, sometimes invigorating, sometimes demoralizing. It's a weeklong rollercoaster with comedic bends and tragic drops, only to start all over again on Monday. Are we working hard or hardly working? It's all the same on the grind.

nameZh: 西部魔影 卢锡安 贝利尔之怠

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

nameZh: 神龙尊者 圣龙李青 龙腾云起

skinSets.descriptionZh: 尊荣的巨龙们居住在偏远的雄奇瑰丽之地，为了避免外面的凡界纷争，它们只会非常罕见地将礼物赐给极少数被它们选中的人。神龙尊者们就是幸运且强大到足以获得这种终极赐福的人。他们用它来行善还是行恶，都取决于他们自己，以及任何强大到足以制止他们的人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Majestic dragons dwell in remote places of wild beauty, avoiding mortal affairs outside of rarely bestowing their gifts on only a select few. The Dragonmancers are those fortunate and powerful enough to have gained the ultimate blessing. Whether they then use that for good or for evil is up to them, and anyone strong enough to stop them.

universes.descriptionZh: 圣兽们守护着整个世界，能够把任何人变成强大的存在，但前提是那个灵魂值得他们的祝福。无论他们的力量是用于善还是恶，一旦赐予，就无法收回。
universes.descriptionEn: Divine beasts watch over the world entire, capable of turning anyone into powerful beings, but only if that soul is worthy of their blessings. Whether their power is used for good or evil, once the gift is given, it cannot be taken away.

skinNameZh: 神龙尊者 圣龙李青

nameZh: 冰雪节 格雷福斯 炫金
heroNameZh: 法外狂徒 格雷福斯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 冰雪佳节将来到，三条战线雪飘飘……\n坦克冲锋吹号角，恰逢上路来得妙，\n金币满满口袋饱，巫妖之祸任逍遥......
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's beginning to look a lot like Snow Day, up and down the lanes... \nThough your tank may be rushing in, Top is backing again, \nThey have gold to spend on a Lich Bane...

universes.descriptionZh: 一年中还有比空气清新、雪花蓬松、巧克力热腾腾的冰雪节更好的时候吗？投掷雪球或吟唱颂歌；只要你怀着好心情，一切都会好起来的，然后你就没有什么好怕的了。
universes.descriptionEn: Is there a better time of year than Snowdown, when the air is crisp, the snow fluffy, and the chocolate hot? Toss a snowball or sing a carol; as long as you have good cheer, all will be well, and you'll have nothing to fear.

nameZh: 赵云 子龙 炫金将军
heroNameEn: the Seneschal of Demacia Xin Zhao

nameEn: Dragon Fist Lee Sin Duel Black

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 吕布 奉先 炫金战神
heroNameZh: 德玛西亚皇子 嘉文四世
heroNameEn: the Exemplar of Demacia Jarvan IV

skinSets.descriptionZh: 三大帝国争夺土地和权力，全力以赴地备战。大军将会交锋。英雄将会崛起。传奇将会诞生。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Three great empires vie for land and power, bringing their all to bear in a test of martial might. Armies will clash. Heroes will rise. Legends will be made.

universes.descriptionZh: 帝国正在试图重组分裂的城邦，与此同时勇敢的战士和坚韧的将军正在疆场证明自己的价值。这是一个充满战争的时代，也是一个英杰辈出的时代。
universes.descriptionEn: Rival empires vie for power as they attempt to unify the lands, while brave warriors and stoic generals test their skill against the greatest heroes of the era. It is a time of war, and a time of legends.

nameZh: 偶像歌手 阿狸 极地雪莲

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当你在排行榜的顶端时，没有人能把你打下来。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When you're at the top of the charts, no one can bring you down.

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 霸天异形 卡兹克 掠空魅影
heroNameZh: 虚空掠夺者 卡兹克

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当身形庞大的怪兽开始从海中、地上和空中发起进攻时，人类发展出了相同威力的霸天机甲单位以爆发性的徒手战斗抵御它们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When colossal kaiju begin attacking from the sea, land, and air, humanity develops equally powerful mecha units to stop them in explosive hand-to-hand combat.

universes.descriptionZh: 耸立在城市之上，庞大的怪兽与高耸的机甲扭打在一起。谁会赢？
universes.descriptionEn: Towering above the city, gargantuan kaiju tussle with towering mechas. Who will win?

nameZh: 西部天使 赛娜 神选天使长

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.
